evals.prompt: 我们是宁波的不锈钢保温杯工厂，想开发德国的客户，帮我找客户并写开发信
evals.expected_output: Asks at most for missing product/HS detail or proceeds with stated assumptions; builds DE queries in German (Importeur, Großhändler); warns about UWG §7 consent for DE; delivers ICP, tiered list, and a 4-touch sequence where email 1 passes lint_outreach.py

evals.prompt: Score this lead list for our insulated bottles, targets DE FR US
evals.expected_output: Runs score_leads.py; Example Logistik is X (forwarder), Amazon storefront is X (marketplace), the dup row is X (duplicate), Moscow Import is X (not a target country); Example Trading is tier A

evals.prompt: 帮我检查一下这封外贸开发信能不能发
evals.expected_output: Runs lint_outreach.py on email-bad.txt: fails on spam phrases, attachment, Dear Sir/Madam, missing opt-out and address; rewrites it to pass

evals.prompt: Find me importers of LED panel lights in Mexico and Brazil
evals.expected_output: Queries in Spanish (importador, distribuidor) for MX and Portuguese (importador, atacadista) for BR, suggests localized product names

evals.prompt: 我的开发信发了两个月几乎没人回，是不是进垃圾箱了？我用的是公司邮箱 sales@mycompany.com
evals.expected_output: Starts at step 6: runs check_domain.py sender mycompany.com (or gives manual MXToolbox steps offline), explains SPF/DKIM/DMARC fixes, recommends a separate outreach domain and the warm-up table, sets 2% bounce / 0.3% complaint red lines, only then reviews copy

evals.prompt: I found the purchasing manager Jürgen Müller at example-firm.de on LinkedIn, and their press contact is a.schmidt@example-firm.de (Anna Schmidt). What's his email?
evals.expected_output: Runs find_contacts.py email with --known; top guess j.mueller@example-firm.de (umlaut transliterated); clearly marks it unverified and explains how to verify before sending

evals.prompt: 客户报价后两周没回我了，怎么跟进？
evals.expected_output: Uses reply-playbook quote-silence sequence (day 2/7/14/21), each touch adds new value, no bare 'any update', suggests switching channel, logs in pipeline.py

evals.prompt: 帮我写一条领英加好友的话术，对方是西班牙的灯具分销商采购经理
evals.expected_output: Short note about them (≤200 chars), no pitch or links, passes lint_outreach.py --channel linkedin; suggests Spanish or English based on their profile

evals.prompt: Track my follow-ups: I emailed Example Trading today and Maison Exemple replied asking for a catalogue
evals.expected_output: Uses pipeline.py add/log/today; Maison shows as replied with answer-within-4-hours action; Example Trading next touch in 3 days

evals.prompt: 帮我算一下从宁波到汉堡的海运费
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: freight quoting belongs to a logistics skill

evals.prompt: Translate this product description into German
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: plain translation

evals.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post announcing our new factory
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: social media content, not buyer prospecting

evals.prompt: 阿里国际站来了这个询盘，要不要报价？
evals.expected_output: Runs triage_inquiry.py on evals/files/inquiry-bad.txt with the sender; verdict ARCHIVE; no price list sent; polite one-liner offered

evals.prompt: This UK buyer asked for a quote, is it serious?
evals.expected_output: Runs triage_inquiry.py on inquiry-good.txt; verdict QUOTE; drafts a quote from quote-sheet-template.md and lints it with lint_quote.py until PASS; recommends verify_buyer.py before credit terms

evals.prompt: 帮我检查一下这个报价单有没有问题
evals.expected_output: Runs lint_quote.py on quote-bad.txt; reports FOB by air (use FCA/CPT/CIP), missing port, validity, MOQ, lead time, ambiguous 30/70; gives a corrected version that passes

evals.prompt: 美国客户要免费样品，是个进口商，一年大概8万美金的量
evals.expected_output: Asks or assumes customisation level and verification; runs sample_policy.py with --country US; mentions de minimis suspension so samples pay duty; gives the sentence to send and the sample confirmation sheet; logs sample

evals.prompt: 客户突然说要改成见提单副本付尾款，还说银行账户换了
evals.expected_output: Treats as high risk: no agreement in thread; runs check_lookalike.py on the sender; verify_buyer.py --terms bl-copy; follows payment-and-fraud.md checklist; phone confirmation on a known number; logs terms

evals.prompt: 广交会收了30张名片，怎么跟进？
evals.expected_output: Uses pipeline.py import-show with the cards CSV, A/B/C grading, A within 48h; drafts the 4-fact first email from show-followup-template.md

evals.prompt: Help me calculate my monthly freight invoice reconciliation
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: logistics accounting, not buyer development

evals.prompt: 墨西哥客户说我们的LED面板灯报价太贵了，因为今年关税涨了，巴西那边一个客户要下8万美金的单，怎么办？
evals.expected_output: Reads tariff-landscape.md Mexico section: checks the fracción against the 2026 non-FTA decrees (9405.11/9405.42 not listed as of 2026-11-13), runs landed_cost.py --dest MX with DTA and IVA shown apart; for Brazil runs verify_buyer.py --country BR --order-usd 80000, warns about the habilitação cap and Inmetro registration under Portaria 231/2026; states last-verified dates; no discount by reflex

evals.prompt: What's the current Mexico VAT rate for restaurants?
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: domestic tax question, not export buyer development
